# Sprmal Eco-Friendly Bamboo Toothbrush 5-Pack

Plastic toothbrushes are made from petroleum, and roughly a billion end up in U.S. landfills each year. Sprmal's natural bamboo toothbrushes offer a practical alternative for everyday brushing.

## Biodegradable Bamboo Handles

Each handle is made from 100% organic, biodegradable bamboo. Bamboo is naturally water-resistant, so you can rinse your brush and return it to its holder without drying it first. Many customers also find the handle comfortable to hold.

## Soft Nylon Bristles for Daily Care

BPA-free soft nylon bristles are designed to help remove stains, tartar, and plaque while staying gentle on sensitive gums. Brushing feels comfortable, which makes a healthy routine easier to keep.

## Plastic-Free Packaging

Sprmal ships in recycled brown paper with no plastic. Less plastic in your bathroom means less waste heading to landfills.

## Individually Numbered for Your Household

Each brush is individually numbered, so every family member keeps their own. The Buy 4, Get 1 Free offer makes it easy to stock up for the whole household.

## Shop With Confidence

Sprmal stands behind its quality. If you're not satisfied for any reason, you'll receive a full refund.

## Make the Switch Today

Add the Sprmal Bamboo Toothbrush 5-Pack to your cart and start brushing with a lighter footprint.
